g.text: Graph A draws only persisted links, and every edge names the stored field that establishes it. Top: node kinds and their main links. Bottom: the full edge catalogue.
adaptation, evaluation, risk_finding, cultural_profile, arena, market_comparison to
evidence to adaptation, evaluation, risk_finding, cultural_profile,
risk_finding to the scanned version or adaptation
Node: id, kind, label, evidence_type, claim_type, retrieval_mode, is_demo,
confidence_label, limitations, ref (resource, id, url). Edge: id, source, target, relation,
Evidence node kind: qloo_source is source_signal, model_interpretation is interpretation,
claim_type hypothesis is hypothesis, synthetic records are synthetic_result, anything else
Landscape: group similar_to group (cosine over interest weights, threshold 0.2),
shares_evidence, has_interest, in_region; evidence supports group.
Reaction map: group reacted_to campaign element, mentions theme, feels reaction.
Diffusion: post influenced post (seen_post_ids), post replied_to post (parent_post_id).
